premise: Leo misses green, growing things; Maya can't give him a garden, so she shows him a moon rock that twinkles all over with crystals: the Moon's own kind of garden.
inspiration: 'Stone Soup' (European folk tale), where a plain stone becomes a feast, turned: the stone itself is the gift.
lesson: A friend helps you see what's beautiful right where you are.

en-US.title: A Rock Garden for Leo
en-US.text: {man:enter} Leo missed green things. Trees. Grass. Whole gardens of flowers. {man:face sad} [sighs] Here, everything was grey. Everything except his one little {seedling:enter} seedling, in its dome on the plain. {seedling:live} It stretched up and opened a leaf. But it was only one. {woman:enter} Maya saw him sigh. {woman:face sad} She couldn't give him a garden. Or could she? {woman:face happy} {woman:says} [mischievously] “Come with me.” {woman:go to crater} {man:go to crater} [curious] At the crater's edge, she pointed at a round grey {moon-rock:enter} moon rock. Plain. Dusty. Ordinary. {canvas:glints 0.5 10s} {sfx:twinkle} Then the sunlight caught it. {moon-rock:live hold} It tipped in the dust and twinkled all over with tiny crystals. {man:face surprised} [gasps] Around it, the dust began to sparkle too, like a garden of lights. {woman:says} [warmly] “A rock garden. The Moon's own kind.” {man:face happy} {man:hearts} {man:says} “It's perfect.” [softly] {woman:hearts} {seedling:sparkle} So now Leo had two gardens: one green, and one that twinkled.

es-ES.title: Un jardín de piedra para Leo
es-ES.text: {man:enter} Leo echaba de menos las cosas verdes. Árboles. Hierba. Jardines enteros de flores. {man:face sad} [sighs] Aquí todo era gris. Todo menos su pequeño {seedling:enter} brote, en su cúpula en la llanura. {seedling:live} Se estiró y abrió una hoja. Pero era solo uno. {woman:enter} Maya lo vio suspirar. {woman:face sad} No podía regalarle un jardín. ¿O sí? {woman:face happy} {woman:says} [mischievously] «Ven conmigo.» {woman:go to crater} {man:go to crater} [curious] En el borde del cráter, señaló una {moon-rock:enter} roca lunar gris y redonda. Sencilla. Polvorienta. Normal. {canvas:glints 0.5 10s} {sfx:twinkle} Entonces le dio la luz del sol. {moon-rock:live hold} Se inclinó en el polvo y brilló entera, llena de cristalitos. {man:face surprised} [gasps] A su alrededor, el polvo también empezó a centellear, como un jardín de luces. {woman:says} [warmly] «Un jardín de piedra. El que tiene la Luna.» {man:face happy} {man:hearts} {man:says} «Es perfecto.» [softly] {woman:hearts} {seedling:sparkle} Así que ahora Leo tenía dos jardines: uno verde, y otro que brillaba.

twinkle.prompt: a soft shimmer of many tiny glassy chimes, delicate and magical
